pkgmetadata.longdescription: Binary package of the Dyalog APL interpreter (Unicode, 64-bit), based on the Arch Linux AUR dyalog-bin package. The interpreter is installed under /opt/mdyalog so that vendor scripts keep working. Dyalog is proprietary; unregistered use is for non-commercial evaluation only.
